patches.description: Replaces the launcher icon, the start animation and the SoundCloud logo icons with the Arsound icon.
patches.name: Arsound branding

patches.description: Uses a separate Android account type, so the app can sign in while the original SoundCloud app is installed. Required with "Change package name".
patches.name: Change account type

patches.description: Appends ".revanced" to the package name by default. Changing the package name of the app can lead to unexpected issues.
patches.name: Change package name

options.description: The name of the package to rename the app to.
options.name: Package name

options.description: Update compatibility receiver permissions. Enabling this can fix installation errors, but this can also break features in certain apps.
options.name: Update permissions

options.description: Update provider names declared by the app. Enabling this can fix installation errors, but this can also break features in certain apps.
options.name: Update providers

patches.description: Adds an option to prevent SoundCloud from requesting audio, video and banner advertisements.
patches.name: Control playback advertisements

patches.description: Changes the app name shown on the home screen and in the "Open with" dialog.
patches.name: Custom app name

patches.description: Adds an option to disable SoundCloud's telemetry system.
patches.name: Disable telemetry

patches.description: Adds a "Download file" button to the track menu and a download check to the playlist menu, for tracks whose artist enabled free downloads.
patches.name: Download tracks

patches.description: Adds an option to hide re-uploads of the same song in home sections and autoplay.
patches.name: Hide duplicate recommendations

patches.description: Adds an option to remove the SoundCloud Go and Go+ offer screen and marketing popups.
patches.name: Hide subscription offers

patches.description: Adds importing audio files, playing them in the SoundCloud player and adding any track to any playlist on this device only.
patches.name: Local music

patches.description: Adds network options to the app HTTP clients, including a developer option that simulates a slow connection.
patches.name: Network

patches.description: Shows stored playlists and albums immediately and refreshes them in the background.
patches.name: Offline first playlists

patches.description: Plays tracks downloaded by Arsound from the file instead of streaming them.
patches.name: Play downloaded files

patches.description: Adds an option to reduce background network polling.
patches.name: Power saving

patches.description: Adds a ReVanced menu to the SoundCloud settings, styled like the app.
patches.name: Settings
